title: Peer documentation conflicts and DWG writer-stage boundary
mode: Primary-source web review and plan-only evidence reconciliation
scope: Recheck current DWG peer operation claims at the documentation-to-writer boundary.
Cross-check a peer's fixed DWG type table against the authoritative ODA specification.
Refine existing comparator admission without adding a peer runtime or test lane.
Preserve local empirical-dispatch rules, fast validation cadence, and non-promoting external gates.

method.kind: Read-only web review of current project README/architecture/type-reference pages and ODA specification extract
method.limitations: The peer documentation pages are mutable main-branch snapshots accessed 2026-10-20. No immutable source commit, executable hash, build provenance, source-code audit, drawing, or runtime result was established. The ft_model table conflict is documentation evidence only and does not prove its parser dispatch is wrong.

sources.revision: Mutable main accessed 2026-10-20; immutable commit and executable not bound
sources.observed: The README describes an experimental R2004-family write/assembly path and DwgFile::to_bytes, while its write CLI is labeled Stage 1 of 5 and explicitly says it does not yet emit valid DWG. It also says the project cannot write R14 or R2007, has no byte-identical DWG roundtrip or automated external CAD acceptance, lacks a DXF parser, and still has incomplete real-file entity decoding.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Project-declared implementation stage and limitations; no valid output, writer acceptance, or parser behavior reproduced.

sources.project: ft_model README, object-type reference, and architecture
sources.revision: Mutable main pages accessed 2026-10-20; source commit and release artifact not bound
sources.observed: The project describes direct DWG/DXF parsing and a 2D scene/render path; its architecture identifies SceneGraph-to-JSON export. Its object-type table says fixed DWG codes 37-39 are reserved.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Documentation-only route and mapping claims; no parser source audit, build, input, or execution.

sources.project: Open Design Alliance Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sources.observed: Section 20.4.41 assigns fixed DWG type 37 to REGION, 38 to 3DSOLID, and 39 to BODY.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Normative wire-layout reference for this mapping; it does not establish the behavior of any peer parser or local empirical type code without sample tracing.

sources.observed: The source table independently lists REGION, 3DSOLID, and BODY in the corresponding fixed-type range.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Cross-check only; ODA remains authoritative and this source does not replace empirical sample tracing.

sources.observed: The plan already inventories ft_model as an optional 2D projection candidate, dwg-rs as an optional structural/read candidate, and separate PAR-06/PAR-07/PAR-14/PAR-49 evidence gates.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Plan reconciliation only; no code or tests were run.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-06/PAR-49: require each peer claim to name the exact operation, stage, version, artifact, and per-object disposition; mutable docs and issue labels are not output validation.
PAR-07/S8: keep typed records, opaque-carrier retention, writer assembly, strict independent reopen, ACIS semantics, and native consumer acceptance as separate outcomes.
PAR-14: keep peer builds/runs outside the fast slice loop and continue local implementation when optional evidence is unavailable.

planChanges: Recorded dwg-rs's distinction between experimental R2004-family serializer/assembly components and the Stage-1 CLI path that explicitly does not yet emit a valid DWG; no writer-support claim is inferred.

Cross-checked ft_model's reserved-37-to-39 type-table claim against ODA §20.4.41 and LibreDWG's fixed-type table; documented the contradiction as a peer documentation limit, not a local or peer parser defect.

Kept both repositories unqualified, optional, and outside routine validation; required immutable revision/artifact binding, generated inputs, and source-object disposition before any composed comparison.
Made no change to findings, subplan count, implementation order, validation cadence, or support claims.
